title: Task-template library: /execution's assets/task-templates/execution.json and /frontend's assets/task-templates/frontend.json
description: The normalised format of both libraries (ARCHITECTURE.md 3.2 and 19). /execution's execution.json is written in it; /frontend's frontend.json is written in /frontend's own format (its task-templates.schema.json) and reaches this shape through the adapter of contract/FRONTEND.md 2.1-2.3, after which it is validated here (contract/SCHEMAS.md 6.2 step 1). Templates are data: `exec.py plan instantiate` expands them deterministically into plan tasks, resolving every dependency at instantiation, never at runtime. Strings may hold {placeholders} (SCHEMAS.md section 6 lists the closed vocabulary); an unknown placeholder is an instantiation error.

parameters.description: Declared parameters of the library; instantiation refuses an undeclared one and fills defaults. Values come from the planner's draft (libraries[].params / instances[].params) or from the profile when `from_profile` names a JSON pointer.

condition.description: A predicate over the library parameters and two profile facts. Absent = always.

template.description: Another template of this library (bare id) or of the other library (library:id). Dropped when that template is not included for these parameters, unless `required` is true (then instantiation fails).

ref.description: @spec-approved: the plan-approval decision task. @project-name: the name decision task, created only when profile.project.name_owner_confirmed is false (otherwise the dependency is dropped). @feature-tasks: the build tasks whose covers intersect this instance's group requirements (per: feature-group only); at least one must exist, unless every ui requirement of the group is status_expected planned (then the dependency is dropped). @all-instances:<template id>: every instance of a per-group template. @build-complete: the build-complete gate task. @harden-review: the manual task reviewing and merging the /harden branch. @fix-gate: the newest non-superseded execution:EX-FIX-GATE task (the placeholder regression gate, or the one a fix cycle added). @contract-wave: every task of phase contract. @deliverables-before-screenshots: every deliverable-phase task except submit, flip and tag templates.

nfr.description: rule nfr: the library-standard requirement this template exists for; instantiate adds it to plan.requirements (source execution:standard or frontend:standard) once, numbered NFR-900 upward in library order, unless the draft already holds a requirement with the same nfr key.

include.description: Whether a whole-library instantiation includes this template.

per.description: feature-group: one task per plan feature group that has ui requirements (FE-1x).

estimate.description: Per mode (full, small) or default; the instance's params.mode picks one.

proof.description: The plan proof object (plan.schema.json#/$defs/proof) with placeholders in its strings; validated after substitution. /frontend proofs chain the build and frontend-check: `pnpm -C {ui_root} build && node {frontend_skill}/scripts/frontend-check.mjs --json --gates <list> --features {features} --profile {profile_abs} --root {repo_rel_root} --serve {ui_root}/dist`.

manual.description: plan.schema.json#/$defs/manual with placeholders; latest_start_utc may be the token {latest_start:<anchor_ref>:<offset_min>} resolved at instantiation.

anchor.description: plan.schema.json#/$defs/anchor for clock tasks (T-6h audit, recon passes, freshness re-runs).

prework_class.description: research may run before T0 (FE-00..FE-02 with --state <private_dir>/frontend/); design and code get release_utc = profile.prework.until_utc when profile.prework forbids them.

owner.description: Default agent; manual and decision templates name devA (reassigned by the planner).

decision_kind.description: Decision templates only: the kind of the proposal `manual post` opens for the instance (copied to the task's params.decision_kind). Default plan-task; EX-FIX-SELECT uses fix-selection (owner-only).
